_note: Gifts, limb (iii)(B): other property bought below its value, each on its own (W-156f2, D-352; D-201). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(2)(m)(iii): "(B) for a consideration which is less than the aggregate fair market value of the property by an amount exceeding ₹ 50000, the aggregate fair market value of such property as exceeds such consideration" (p.139). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.56(2)(x)(c)(B), the same with "fifty thousand rupees". The fair market value is entered (S4 r.57). Introduction and provenance are OS-GIFT's. Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-17-gifts.md A1, B1.
